entities.name: María Luisa Escobar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Luisa González Gragirena de Escobar was a Venezuelan musicologist, pianist, composer, and caricaturist. She founded the Caracas Athenaeum in 1931. She also served as President of the Venezuelan Red Cross.
